text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since serving
as Sasami Anshinzawa's guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going out with her,
I'd train to get closer to an Umamusume and receive treatments...
Then, one day during that routine――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh♪ Your body's shaping up
quite nicely to my liking, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
With this, you can enter too...
The legendary stage that everyone dreams of――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Onward to the "Sasabariwinkle Series"!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
You don't know what *that* is?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
A mega-event of the sasabari world where humans enhanced by sasabari needles compete in races!
That's the "Sasabari Twinkle Series"!
choice_data_list: Besides…… you're saying I should enter?
Besides…… you're saying I should enter?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeeeed♪ Runner: you, Trainer: me—the ultimate dream team!
We've practically already won, wouldn't ya say~?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, my my~??
You don't look all that thrilled, do you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen, okay? If you run in races,
you can use that experience in your trainee's workouts!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Watching and actually doing it are completely different!
You've come to realize that from all your training
so far, haven't you? No, you definitely have!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You want to make <chrname>
even stronger, right?
You want to make her dream come true, don't you??

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then you've got no choice but to enter!
That's the reeeal safe bet here♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!! Alright, settled! It's totally official!
I'm gonna go register for the race right now~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If you take the crown,
my skills will be recognized too, killing two birds with one stone♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, my three-legged race of days
with Sasami Anshinzawa began!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is the pinnacle of the Sasabarinckle Series!
In other words, absolute victory in the Sasabari Cup ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
To accomplish that, I must build up my track record
and earn the right to enter the race!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
First, our goal is to win the upcoming
Bamboo Stakes!
So-that-means~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I need you to undergo
more advanced training――let's see~
something around Lv5!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here goes~! Shotgun Touch!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Next up: high-speed doggy paddle!
Woof woof, super faaaast☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Breaking tiles with an 'Ossu!' Totally safe and sound~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Safe and sound! Nice and chill!
Pull that tire to the rhythm of the drill~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The final showdown will be shogi!
Think you can beat me...? Wait, checkmate?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work~.
Whoa, you look totally wiped out~!
choice_data_list: My body's just reached its absolute limit...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ In that case, Trainer Anshinzawa will give you a very special treatment, just for you☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Alright, go-go to the infirmary!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now this right here is the "Ascension Bliss Pressure Point"â
it's a secret healing spot that blows all your fatigue away in one go! âª
choice_data_list: Your name doesn't sound very re-assuuuring...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true at all~!
I'm pretty sure the book said so~?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: And so! Down the hatch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I opened my eyes, I found myself standing in an unfamiliar place.
I'm fairly sure I was receiving Sasabari acupuncture treatment, but—
Trainer... Trainer, canst thou hear my voice?

I am the God of Sasabari...
One who bestows blessings upon thee who striveth for the pinnacle of the Sasabari-inkle Series—

text_block_list.name: God of Sasabari?
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, surely you desire the power
to seize glory, do you not?

text_block_list.name: God of Sasabari?
text_block_list.text:
Nay, no answer is necessary. You obviously desire it.
Therefore, I shall grant it unto you!

text_block_list.name: God of Sasabari?
text_block_list.text: —*Stabbity-stab*!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What absolute omnipotence...
Is this... the power bestowed by God...?!

text_block_list.name: God of Sasabari?
text_block_list.text: Fwahaha... Please look after that scatterbrained acupuncturist for me, will you...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally awake~?
Feel refreshed, right?! A total success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, my physical condition is top-notch.
It feels like all my fatigue has completely vanished.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo grass acupuncture really solves everything after all, doesn't it?♪
Rest aaassuuured☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this... power bestowed by God...?
It doesn't seem like much after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I feel like my vitality is being sucked out in reverse.
All my strength is draining away...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, oh my~? How very odd~?
There shouldn't be any mistakes in my treatment,
since I am the divine Sasabari acupuncturist~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever!
Let's hang out again next time we get the chance~☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're finally awake~!
You were tossing and turning quite a bit, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm heading home!
See ya~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I missed the pressure point by like a millimeter,
but that should be fine, right? Yep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether from being tossed about by nonsensical dreams or from a botched treatment... the fatigue hardly seemed relieved at all.
